name: fetch-tw-earnings-call
description: Download Taiwan-listed companies' earnings-call (法說會) presentations and transcripts (Chinese + English) by stock id. Fetches directly from authoritative sources — company IR sites and the 公開資訊觀測站 (MOPS) public listing endpoint — then merges and md5-dedupes across sources. Free for noncommercial use (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0); commercial use requires a paid license (see COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md).
